summary: Plan BI priorities, governance, and a phased roadmap with practical frameworks. Explore the five-day foundation course and build a decision-ready plan.
lede: Business intelligence planning connects data capabilities and decision needs with business priorities, governance, investment, and sequenced delivery. For BI leads, analysts, and business sponsors, this course supports practical roadmap decisions by assessing current maturity, mapping KPI needs and dependencies, and prioritizing initiatives. Learners then shape a phased roadmap with owners and measures for tracking progress.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape business intelligence priorities, evaluate reporting needs, or coordinate the people and data required to deliver BI initiatives.
modules: TDWI Maturity Model and BI Baseline
BI Roadmap Governance and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with business reporting, KPIs, or data use is helpful. No programming is required; exercises focus on planning artefacts and decision tools rather than software configuration.
